title: HR Executive / HR & Office Administration Executive
description:
HR Executive / HR & Office Administration Executive Location: Hyderabad, India
 Company: Intelex Systems Private Limited
 Department: Human Resources / Administration
 Employment Type: Full-time
 Experience: 1 - 5 years preferred
 Reporting To: Management / Operations Head 
 Role Summary Intelex Systems Private Limited is looking for a proactive and well-organised HR Executive / HR & Office Administration Executive to support day-to-day HR operations, recruitment, office administration and general employee coordination at our Hyderabad office. The ideal candidate should be comfortable handling recruitment activities, employee records, attendance and leave coordination, HR documentation, office administration, vendor coordination and general administrative support. Experience with KeKa HR Suite will be highly preferred. A candidate with basic accounting or finance administration exposure will be an added advantage. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 HR Operations Maintain employee records, personal files and HR documentation in an organised and confidential manner. Manage employee onboarding and exit formalities. Support attendance, leave and timesheet coordination. Assist with payroll inputs, LOP tracking, employee data validation and HR reports. Coordinate employee documentation including ID proofs, educational certificates, bank details, joining forms and relieving documents. Support HR policy communication and ensure employees follow internal processes. Maintain HR trackers for attendance, leave, appraisals, probation reviews and employee confirmations. Recruitment Coordinate end-to-end recruitment activities for technical and non-technical roles. Post job requirements on job portals, LinkedIn and other recruitment channels. Screen CVs and shortlist suitable candidates. Schedule interviews with internal teams and follow up on feedback. Communicate with candidates professionally throughout the recruitment process. Prepare selection emails, offer-related documentation and joining communication. Maintain recruitment trackers and candidate records. KeKa HR Suite Management Maintain employee profiles, attendance, leave and HR records in KeKa. Support employees with basic KeKa queries. Coordinate with KeKa support for technical or configuration-related issues. Ensure HR data in KeKa is accurate and up to date. Generate reports from KeKa where required. Office Administration Manage day-to-day office administration activities. Maintain office files, registers, records and internal documentation. Coordinate office supplies, stationery, pantry items and general requirements. Liaise with vendors, service providers and maintenance teams. Support travel, accommodation and meeting arrangements where required. Assist with visitor coordination and office access arrangements. Ensure the office environment is organised, professional and well maintained. General Administration and Coordination Support management with general administrative tasks. Prepare letters, emails, notices and internal communication when required. Maintain trackers for company assets, employee equipment and office inventory. Assist with employee engagement activities and internal events. Coordinate with UK and India teams where required. Support compliance documentation and audit preparation. Accounting / Finance Support Added Advantage Candidates with basic accounting knowledge will be preferred. Responsibilities may include: Assisting with invoice filing and basic payment follow-ups. Coordinating expense records and supporting documentation. Maintaining petty cash or office expense records where required. Supporting the accounts team with basic administrative tasks. Coordinating vendor bills and approvals. Required Skills and Experience 1 to 5 years of experience in HR, recruitment or office administration. Good understanding of HR processes, employee records and documentation. Experience using KeKa HR Suite or similar HRMS platform preferred. Good communication skills in English. Strong organisational and follow-up skills. Ability to handle confidential information responsibly. Good working knowledge of MS Office, especially Excel, Word and Outlook. Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks. Professional attitude and good interpersonal skills. Basic accounting or finance administration knowledge will be an advantage. Preferred Candidate Profile The ideal candidate should be: Responsible, reliable and process-oriented. Comfortable working in a growing technology company. Able to coordinate with employees, candidates, vendors and management. Good at maintaining records and following up on pending tasks. Polite, professional and clear in communication. Flexible to support both HR and office administration responsibilities. Educational Qualification Bachelors degree in HR, Business Administration, Commerce or related field. MBA HR or relevant HR certification will be an added advantage. What We Offer Opportunity to work with a growing UK and India-based technology company. Exposure to HR operations, recruitment, administration and business support. Professional work environment. Opportunity to work closely with management and cross-functional teams. Career growth based on performance and contribution. 
 Job Summary for Posting Intelex Systems Private Limited, Hyderabad is hiring an HR Executive / HR & Office Administration Executive to manage HR operations, recruitment, KeKa HRMS coordination, employee documentation, office administration and general administrative support. KeKa experience is preferred, and basic accounting knowledge will be an added advantage.

title: Factory Human Resource Manager
description:
Job Title: HR Manager/Assistant HR Manager (Biscuit Manufacturing Unit)
Location: Kattedan IDA, Hyderabad, India

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced HR Manager/Assistant HR Manager to lead the Human Resources function in a biscuit manufacturing unit @ Kattedan IDA, Hyderabad. The role involves managing end-to-end HR operations, supporting plant workforce management, ensuring statutory compliance, and driving a high-performance culture in a fast-paced FMCG manufacturing environment handling 800 plus workmen and 120 plus staff. 
Working timelines - 6 Days Working , Sunday-Weekly off (With One Sunday in a month required for Factory Audits/Payments etc-In lieu of which Compensatory off will need to be taken in the same week), 930 AM to 630 PM, Work from Office only. 
 Key Responsibilities
1. HR Strategy & Business Partnering
Align HR strategies with plant and business objectives 
Act as a strategic partner to plant leadership and functional heads 
Drive organizational effectiveness and workforce planning 

2. Talent Acquisition & Workforce Planning
Manage end-to-end recruitment for plant roles (operators, engineers, quality, support functions) 
Develop manpower plans for shifts and production requirements 
Ensure timely hiring of skilled and semi-skilled workforce 

3. Employee Relations & Industrial Relations (IR)
Manage employee relations in a manufacturing environment 
Handle union interactions (if applicable) and maintain harmonious IR climate 
Address grievances, disciplinary issues, and conflict resolution 

4. Performance Management
Drive performance appraisal systems and goal setting (KPIs/KRAs) 
Support managers in performance reviews and development planning 
Identify and manage high-potential talent 

5. Learning & Development
Identify training needs across plant functions 
Design and implement technical, behavioral, and safety training programs 
Build capability for shop-floor employees and leadership pipeline 

6. Compensation & Benefits
Manage payroll inputs, attendance, and shift allowances 
Benchmark compensation within FMCG/manufacturing industry 
Administer employee benefits and welfare programs 

7. Statutory Compliance
Ensure compliance with labor laws such as: 
Factories Act, 1948 
Industrial Disputes Act, 1947 
Employees' Provident Funds and Miscellaneous Provisions Act, 1952 
Employees' State Insurance Act, 1948 
Maintain statutory records, registers, and audit readiness 

8. HR Operations & Administration
Oversee attendance, leave management, and HR documentation 
Maintain employee records and HRIS systems 
Ensure smooth onboarding and exit processes 

9. Culture & Engagement
Drive employee engagement initiatives and retention strategies 
Promote a positive, inclusive, and performance-driven culture 
Organize welfare activities for plant employees 

10. Health, Safety & Welfare
Support implementation of safety policies in coordination with EHS team 
Ensure employee welfare facilities (canteen, transport, amenities) 
Promote awareness of workplace safety and hygiene 

Qualifications & Experience
MBA / PGDM in Human Resources or related field or Any Graduate
5 to 10 plus years of HR experience in manufacturing (FMCG preferred) 
Experience in biscuits, bakery, chocolates, or confectionery industry is highly desirable 

Key Skills
Strong knowledge of industrial relations and labor laws 
Experience managing shop-floor workforce 
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills 
Conflict resolution and negotiation skills 
HR analytics and data-driven decision-making

Key Skills: Factory HR,Plant HR,Contract Labour Management,Salary Administration,Manpower Planning,HR MIS,Payroll Management,Industrial Relations

title: Admin & HR Executive
description:
Role As an Admin & HR Executive , you will be responsible for supporting the complete employee lifecycle, from recruitment and onboarding through to employee administration, payroll coordination and day-to-day office operations. You will also support the management team with general administration, documentation, vendor coordination and compliance-related activities. We are looking for someone who is organised, dependable, people-oriented and comfortable working in a fast-moving startup environment . 
 Key Responsibilities Recruitment & Hiring Coordinate recruitment activities for technical and non-technical positions. Post job vacancies on LinkedIn, Naukri and other relevant recruitment platforms. Review CVs and shortlist candidates based on agreed requirements. Coordinate interviews between candidates and hiring managers. Manage interview schedules and candidate communications. Maintain recruitment trackers and candidate records. Coordinate offer letters and joining formalities. Build relationships with recruitment agencies and external hiring partners where required. Employee Onboarding & Offboarding Manage new employee onboarding and joining documentation. Coordinate employee background verification where applicable. Set up employee records and HR documentation. Coordinate IT equipment, email accounts, access and other joining requirements. Conduct or coordinate employee induction and orientation. Manage exit formalities, company property returns and final documentation. Maintain accurate employee information throughout the employee lifecycle. HR Administration Maintain employee records, personnel files and HR databases. Track leave, attendance and employee-related information. Coordinate payroll inputs with the company's payroll provider/Finance team. Support employee benefits administration. Prepare standard HR letters and documents, including employment confirmations, experience letters and other HR documentation. Maintain HR policies, procedures and employee handbooks. Support performance review and appraisal processes. Assist management with employee engagement initiatives. Office Administration Manage day-to-day office administration. Coordinate office supplies, equipment and facilities. Liaise with landlords, vendors, service providers and other external parties. Manage travel and accommodation arrangements where required. Maintain records for office expenses and administrative contracts. Organise meetings, events and team activities. Ensure the office environment is well organised and professionally maintained. Compliance & Documentation Coordinate with external HR, payroll, CA/CS and legal advisors on routine compliance matters. Maintain employment and statutory documentation. Support compliance with applicable employment and labour requirements. Ensure HR records and documentation are complete and up to date. Maintain confidentiality of employee and company information. Management Support Provide administrative support to the Founder and management team. Prepare HR and administrative reports and trackers. Support budgeting and monitoring of HR/admin expenses. Assist with setting up new HR processes as the company grows. Take ownership of administrative tasks and follow them through to completion. Required Skills & Experience Essential 2-6 years of experience in HR administration, HR operations, office administration or a similar role . Good understanding of recruitment and employee lifecycle processes. Strong organisational and administrative skills. Good written and verbal communication skills. Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office / Google Workspace. Ability to maintain accurate records and trackers. Strong attention to detail. Ability to handle confidential information professionally. Good interpersonal skills and ability to work with employees at all levels. Ability to work independently in a startup environment. Desirable Experience working in a technology or startup company. Experience recruiting software engineers or technical professionals. Familiarity with HRMS/HRIS platforms. Basic knowledge of Indian payroll and employment processes. Experience coordinating with payroll providers, consultants or recruitment agencies. Familiarity with employee engagement and performance management processes. Experience using LinkedIn Recruiter, Naukri or other recruitment platforms. Basic understanding of employment documentation and statutory compliance. 
 What We Are Looking For We are looking for someone who is: Organised able to manage multiple HR and administrative activities without losing track of details. Proactive identifies issues and takes action rather than waiting for instructions. Reliable follows through on commitments and deadlines. People-oriented approachable and able to build positive relationships with employees and candidates. Confidential understands the importance of handling employee and company information responsibly. Adaptable – comfortable working in an early-stage company where processes are still being established. Professional – represents the company positively when dealing with candidates, employees, vendors and external partners. 


 Perks and benefits 
 Why Join Us? This is an opportunity to join an AI startup at an early stage and help build the company's people and administrative infrastructure from the ground up. You will have the opportunity to: Work closely with the Founder and management team. Help build HR processes for a growing technology company. Recruit and support a talented AI engineering team. Gain broad exposure to startup operations. Take ownership of important people and administrative processes. Grow with the company as the organisation expands across India and international markets. Compensation Competitive salary + performance incentives , depending on experience and capability. Application Please share your CV along with a brief summary of your experience in: Recruitment HR administration Employee onboarding Payroll coordination Office administration Working in a startup or technology environment
